metadata.summary: The 2020 PhysioNet/CinC Challenge aimed to develop algorithms to classify cardiac abnormalities from 12-lead ECG recordings. The public training set comprised ~43,000 12-lead ECGs aggregated from six sources (including inpatient/outpatient clinics in China, the US, and Germany, plus existing databases such as CPSC, CPSC-Extra, PTB, and others), labeled for a set of diagnostic classes (originally 9, expanded to 27/96-class variants).
metadata.purpose: To develop algorithms to classify cardiac abnormalities from 12-lead ECG recordings.

papers.title: PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology (CinC) Challenge 2020: Classifying Cardiac Abnormalities from 12-lead ECGs

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.

known_limitations: Mixed at-rest and other recording settings
bias_and_limitations.modifications: Yes — labels harmonized and expanded (9 → 27/96 classes); data aggregated and preprocessed for challenge use.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Overrepresentation of data from specific geographic regions (China, US, Germany) and underrepresentation of other populations; limited demographic reporting.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Generalizability may be limited by heterogeneous recording conditions, device variability, and geographic/clinical setting bias.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: Geographic subgroups covered (China, US, Germany); no reported coverage by age, sex, or ethnicity.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: No explicit description of missing data volume or patterns.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Aggregated from six sources including inpatient/outpatient clinics in China, the US, and Germany, plus existing databases (CPSC, CPSC-Extra, PTB, etc.) to enable robust multi-class rhythm/diagnosis classification under heterogeneous conditions.
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Heterogeneous sampling across clinical settings and public databases; no explicit random or stratified sampling described.
data_origin.aggregation_multisource: Aggregated from six sources: inpatient/outpatient clinics in China, US, Germany, and existing databases (CPSC, CPSC-Extra, PTB, and others); labels harmonized across sources with original 9-class schema later expanded to 27/96-class variants.

population.target_population: Patients undergoing 12-lead ECG recording in inpatient or outpatient clinical settings.

annotation.annotation_method: Labels derived from clinical interpretation (e.g., physician-reviewed reports or database ground truth); harmonized across sources.
annotation.labeling_provenance: Labels sourced from clinical reports and existing public ECG databases (CPSC, PTB, etc.), with harmonization and expansion.
annotation.label_noise_description: Label noise across sources due to differing annotation standards and clinical contexts.
